verdict.rationale: macOS's Sidecar lets a designer use an iPad as a second Mac display. Apple's docs explicitly target creative apps: Apple Pencil works in InDesign, Affinity Photo 2 and ZBrush, and the main canvas can sit on one display with tools and palettes on the other. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Sidecar performance in creative workflows.

support.subject: As a designer, I can use a paired tablet device as a secondary display for creative apps

citations.quote: Sidecar allows you to extend your workspace by using your iPad as a second Mac display.
Sidecar brings the ease and precision of Apple Pencil to your favorite creative Mac apps as well.
view your main canvas on one display while spreading out your tools and palettes on the other.
